commands.command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/srv-data-backing/disk0.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
    LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
    losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$IMG"
fi
udevadm settle
vgchange -ay datavg
mkdir -p /srv/data
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/data; then
    mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
fi
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh

commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-setup.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM volume and mount /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh
ExecStop=/usr/bin/umount /srv/data

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable srv-data-setup.service
systemctl is-enabled srv-data-setup.service

sudo mkdir -p /srv/data/app
sudo sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3; do echo "record-$i original" > /srv/data/app/file$i.txt; done'
sudo sh -c 'date > /srv/data/app/created_at.txt'
sudo find /srv/data -type f -exec sh -c 'echo ==={}===; cat {}' \;
sudo sha256sum $(sudo find /srv/data -type f | sort) | tee /tmp/baseline.sha256
